pathsContract: Ruling A8 (the deterministic Phase 1/2 driver consumes this file). Every executable row carries `path`: a JSON array of glob strings. Old-tree globs are relative to the v1 repository root ("packages/graph", "examples/*.jsx"); flows-tree globs carry the prefix `flows:` and are relative to the flows root ("flows:packages/flow", "flows:docs/pages/**"). Brace alternatives and ** are allowed; brace ranges are not; a glob naming a directory covers its whole subtree; no prose, counts, "+", comma lists or absolute paths inside a glob. Every executable row matches at least one file in `git ls-tree -r --name-only <revision>` of its tree (old 9169a943eb, flows 393253c2b). The most specific matching row owns a file (longest literal prefix, then longest glob); a migrate row inside a keep subtree is rewritten in place in Phase 4; a delete or replace row inside a keep subtree carries `allowInsideKeep: true` with the reason in notes. Rows with `executable: false` are advisory (findings, gaps, decisions, limits, human tasks, Plue items, command groups inside one file, root-wiring notes and the flows "not imported" note); they keep a descriptive `path` string and a unique `key`, and the driver skips them. `label` is the human-readable name of every row (the Label column of the Markdown twin); `section` is the Markdown section the row belongs to. `docs/migration/**` is a keep row that the driver excludes from the plan body. Checks: `python3 <scratch>/ledger-driver.py check --ledger docs/migration/disposition-ledger.json --v1 . --flows-repo /Users/williamcory/flows/flows` must print zero PROBLEM lines, zero uncovered and zero ambiguous v1 files; `node docs/migration/check-disposition-ledger.mjs` validates the schema, the globs and the Markdown twin; `docs/migration/phase1-2-plan.json` is the per-file plan the driver wrote from this ledger.

maintainerDecisions.recommendedDefault: Make this repository the only Smithers repository and archive `~/flows/flows` after import verification.
maintainerDecisions.recordedAnswer: This repository is the only Smithers repository. `~/flows/flows` is archived (read-only on GitHub) after Phase 2 import verification.
maintainerDecisions.consequenceAccepted: No sync or dual-release policy. The import is `git archive` of flows `393253c2b` (R-4); flows commits and uncommitted working-tree edits after that commit (70 tracked files on 2026-08-28 22:49 PDT (51 under apps/ui, 13 under apps/shared, 4 under apps/server, pnpm-lock.yaml, .file-routing-fable-draft.md)) are left behind and reach this repository only if the maintainer moves the import reference before Phase 2 and the ledger is regenerated (ledger `flows files not imported` note row: owner the maintainer, exit condition the reference moved and `ledger-driver.py check` and `plan` re-run).

maintainerDecisions.recommendedDefault: Preserve the imported repository's meaningful commit history or retain an immutable import reference/tag.
maintainerDecisions.recordedAnswer: Retain the immutable import reference: tag `import/flows-393253c2b` on the Phase 2 commit that contains the verbatim `git archive` of flows `393253c2b4adb1330fab518a3075b8ecd25cd927`; the archived flows repository holds the commit history. Import fact for `vendor/jj`: flows tracks the gitlink `47589ada70c12b3e829b5c98ab32503abad49eac` at `393253c2b` (`git ls-tree 393253c2b vendor/jj`), a preflight commit one step above the `origin/flows-wasm` tip `ccb7464990a6d41d40aa4c6a4b9d280c93550eea` that changes only `cli/src/config-schema.json`. rc.0 pins the submodule at `47589ada7`, the tracked gitlink (ruling A3b); Phase 2 verifies the pin by rebuilding `packages/jj/wasm/flows_jj.wasm` from `47589ada7` (the `wasm-repro` job) and byte-comparing with the tracked wasm (ledger row `vendor/jj`).
maintainerDecisions.consequenceAccepted: `git log` here does not show flows history; archaeology goes to the archived repository and the tag. The ledger records flows-side copy rows with the disposition `import`, the sixth PLAN Phase 0 disposition (ruling A8), in the same `entries` list as the old-tree rows; every executable row carries a glob `path` array (flows globs prefixed `flows:`) and a `tree` field, and the Phase 1/2 driver check reports zero uncovered and zero ambiguous files (`docs/migration/phase1-2-plan.json` is the committed per-file plan).

maintainerDecisions.recommendedDefault: Start at `1.0.0-rc.0`, then increment `rc.1`, `rc.2`, and so on.
Give all public first-party packages one synchronized RC version.
maintainerDecisions.recordedAnswer: One synchronized version for all 39 public names; private apps and private packages keep their own versions (`smithers-ui 1.0.0`, `smithers-server 1.0.0`, `smithers-shared 0.0.0`, `smithers-tui 0.0.0`).
maintainerDecisions.consequenceAccepted: Every candidate republishes every public package even when unchanged. `set-release-version.mjs` rewrites private-to-private exact ranges, so `build-cli -> targets` and root `-> build-cli/targets` change to `workspace:*` first.

maintainerDecisions.recommendedDefault: Publish only packages required by supported consumers; keep build helpers, targets, fixtures, and internal composition packages private.
maintainerDecisions.consequenceAccepted: Custom run-UI authors have no `gateway-react`/`gateway-ui` at rc.0 (deleted, §3.2); the 0.x terminal monitor is deleted.

maintainerDecisions.recommendedDefault: Publish a deprecation/migration notice only; use explicit `@smthrs/*` packages for new code.
maintainerDecisions.consequenceAccepted: `smthrs@0.35.0` stays `latest` until `1.0.0`; users on `latest` see no change until they read the notice or the docs.

maintainerDecisions.recommendedDefault: Keep the user-facing `smithers` binary and make the imported CLI own it. Resolve the imported `flows` binary and private build CLI's `smthrs` binary before packing.
maintainerDecisions.recordedAnswer: `smithers` owned by `@smthrs/cli`; `flows` bin dropped; build CLI bin renamed `smithers-build` (§3.4).
maintainerDecisions.consequenceAccepted: Plue's `@smithers/cli` drops its `smithers` bin key; `check-local-smithers`, both plugin resolvers, `scripts/BUILD.ts`, targets, generated CI, and docs change in Phase 3.

maintainerDecisions.recommendedDefault: Treat Effect 4 as part of the 1.0 authoring contract and document the exact compatibility range.
maintainerDecisions.recordedAnswer: Effect 4 is part of the authoring contract. Exact pin `4.0.0-rc.108` for `effect`, `@effect/platform-node`, `@effect/platform-node-shared`, `@effect/platform-bun`, `@effect/sql-sqlite-node`, `@effect/opentelemetry`, `@effect/vitest`; compatibility range is that one version (§9).
maintainerDecisions.consequenceAccepted: Consumers cannot float Effect; every RC that moves the pin is a breaking change for consumers, documented per candidate.

maintainerDecisions.recommendedDefault: Ship the first RC as SQLite-only and fail clearly for Postgres/PGlite.
maintainerDecisions.recordedAnswer: SQLite-only; PostgreSQL and PGlite fail with `unsupported_database` (§2).
maintainerDecisions.consequenceAccepted: 0.x PGlite and Postgres users have no data path.

maintainerDecisions.recommendedDefault: Do not migrate live/in-flight 0.x runs; require finish/archive/discard. Decide separately whether completed history gets a read-only importer.
maintainerDecisions.recordedAnswer: No live-run migration; finish, archive, or discard; no read-only history importer in rc.0 (§6).
maintainerDecisions.consequenceAccepted: 0.x run history is unreadable from 1.0 tooling.

maintainerDecisions.recommendedDefault: Require correct cancellation and signals; defer hijack, attributed pause, and continue-as-new only if their commands/exports are removed or explicitly unsupported.
maintainerDecisions.recordedAnswer: Cancel and signals are correct and durable (§5.1). Hijack, attributed pause, and continue-as-new `Continued` are removed with their commands and exports (§5.2).
maintainerDecisions.consequenceAccepted: Operators who used `hijack` or `pause` lose those verbs.

maintainerDecisions.recommendedDefault: Defer for the first RC unless production workflows require them; remove misleading commands and docs.
maintainerDecisions.consequenceAccepted: Plue's tier-2 dev-automation workflows (`alpha-plue`, `fix-all-issues`, `ticket-fleet`) cannot be re-authored 1:1 on rc.0.

maintainerDecisions.recommendedDefault: Claim browser-bundleable APIs, not a durable browser or edge deployment.
maintainerDecisions.consequenceAccepted: No Cloudflare or Vercel engine deployment in rc.0; the 0.x `e2e/runtime` edge lanes are deleted.

maintainerDecisions.recommendedDefault: Use the UI already built in `~/flows/flows` as the product UI. Treat `../multi` as a disposable prototype and UX reference, not a package or release dependency.
maintainerDecisions.recordedAnswer: `apps/ui` from flows is the product UI. `../multi` is a reference only.
maintainerDecisions.consequenceAccepted: `apps/ui` retargets `@smthrs/ui` from registry `0.33.0` to `workspace:*` in Phase 3; `@smthrs/ui` stays a private workspace package (§3.2) and its conformance scan reads the 1.0 sources.

maintainerDecisions.recommendedDefault: Keep generic contracts/actions in core and move vendor/deployment adapters to the plugins repository where possible.
maintainerDecisions.recordedAnswer: Generic contracts, actions, and channels stay in core; the GitHub, Linear, and Telegram integration code is rebuilt in core as `@smthrs/integrations` (ruling A7); vendor and deployment adapters move to the plugins repository behind the §10 prerequisite.
maintainerDecisions.consequenceAccepted: `@smthrs/accounts`, `@smthrs/usage`, `agents` verbs, `claude-shell`, Hermes, OpenClaw, herdr, cloud hosts, and the Claude Code and Codex subprocess agents leave core; core gains a `SeatResolver` seam so a plugin can supply rotating credentials; the plugins repository must first be rebased onto `@smthrs/*` (§10).

maintainerDecisions.recommendedDefault: Ship one canonical migration prompt as both a new-engine workflow and a thin installable skill/CLI entry point.
maintainerDecisions.recordedAnswer: One migration prompt shipped as the `migrate-smithers-v1` flow (`flows/migrate-smithers-v1/flow.ts`), the `smithers migrate` verb, and a `SKILL.md`.
maintainerDecisions.consequenceAccepted: The workflow name must not collide with the reserved `system/migrate` id; that id is retired.

maintainerDecisions.recommendedDefault: State clearly that the RC is a source migration with no JSX or runtime compatibility.
maintainerDecisions.recordedAnswer: Source migration with no JSX or runtime compatibility (§11).
maintainerDecisions.consequenceAccepted: Every 0.x project needs the migration workflow; no shim exists.

maintainerDecisions.recommendedDefault: Migrate Smithers and the unreleased Plue backend together. Plue may not release until it uses the new Smithers contracts. Multi is outside the release train.
maintainerDecisions.recordedAnswer: Smithers and Plue migrate together; Plue does not release until it uses the new contracts (§10). Multi is outside the release train.
maintainerDecisions.consequenceAccepted: Plue's Go provisioning, relay tests, Worker allowlist, agent VM, sandbox plane, CI pipelines, and pack all change before Plue can release.

entries.rationale: Ruling E1: the alias contract is built from the real list, not the earlier estimate (39 and about 80). Plugins and skills depend on SMITHERS_INSIDE_RUN, SMITHERS_RUN_ID, SMITHERS_API_KEY, SMITHERS_GATEWAY_URL; Plue alone reads about 20 engine-facing names: SMITHERS_API_KEY, SMITHERS_BACKEND, SMITHERS_BIN, SMITHERS_CLI, SMITHERS_ORCHESTRATOR_CLI, SMITHERS_TASK_ID, SMITHERS_WORKFLOW_PATH, SMITHERS_WORKFLOW_ROOT, SMITHERS_WORKFLOW_RUN_ID, SMITHERS_YES, SMITHERS_AGENT_SESSION_ID, SMITHERS_AGENT_TOKEN, SMITHERS_AGENT_PROVIDER, SMITHERS_AGENT_TRANSPORT, SMITHERS_API_BASE_URL, SMITHERS_REPOSITORY_PATH, SMITHERS_TASK_PAYLOAD, SMITHERS_DEBUG, SMITHERS_JJHUB_TOKEN, SMITHERS_JJHUB_API_URL (the rest of Plue's SMITHERS_* names are its own Go configuration namespace). Flows reads FLOWS_REMOTE, FLOWS_MCP_CONFIG, FLOWS_OPENAI_AUTH and FLOWS_TEST_* at the import reference and has no credential environment variable (--credential is a declared flag only), so SMITHERS_API_KEY is new Phase 4 work. Ruling F4 (cycle 15, closes E1): rc-contract.md §4 carries the per-variable table for every name Plue sets (rc.0 consumer module, Plue-retained, removed, replacement); this row states the engine-side alias rules only.

entries.path: G-02 process containment: packages/std/src/internal/Exec.ts:100-109 + packages/kernel/src/ChildProcessSpawner.ts:131-133 (no forceKillAfter on any guarded spawn); packages/jj/src/node/NodeJj.ts:17,54 (jj spawned outside the kernel spawner)

entries.newHome: forceKillAfter default (5 s) passed by std Exec.ts and applied by the kernel spawner to every guarded spawn lacking one; new packages/std/test/ExecContainment.test.ts pins (a) Effect's process-group kill on cooperative cancel and (b) the SIGTERM-ignoring child; NodeJj documented as short-lived (triage B-14, W-14)
